title: Units Covered by a Northloop Guarantee Claim on Marketplace Orders
content:
**Rule.** The claimed units of the amount claimed on a Marketplace Orders Northloop Guarantee claim are chosen from the order's return requests: where the order carries both return requests for a seller-fault reason (damage in transit, defective, wrong item, not as described, missing parts) and return requests for a buyer's-remorse reason (no longer needed, better price found, ordered by mistake), the claim covers only the units on the seller-fault requests; where the order carries no return request at all, as on an order that never arrived, the claim covers every unit ordered; otherwise the claim covers the units on every return request of the order.

The item part of the amount claimed is the unit price times the claimed units.

## Choosing the units

| Return requests on the order | Units the claim covers |
|---|---|
| both seller-fault and buyer's-remorse requests | the units on the seller-fault requests only; the units on the buyer's-remorse requests are left out |
| no return request at all | every unit ordered |
| seller-fault requests only | the units on every return request |
| buyer's-remorse requests only | the units on every return request |

Units are read from the units recorded on each return request, and the reason from the reason recorded on it.

## Hypothetical cases

1. An order of 4 units with a request for 1 unit as defective and a request for 2 units as no longer needed: the claim covers 1 unit.
2. An order of 4 units that never arrived and carries no return request: the claim covers 4 units.
3. An order of 4 units with requests for 1 unit as damaged in transit and 1 unit as wrong item: the claim covers 2 units.
4. With a hypothetical unit price of USD 25.00, case 1 gives an item part of USD 25.00 and case 2 an item part of USD 100.00.
